title: Semra, Ghazipur
text: Semara is a village in Ghazipur district, Uttar Pradesh, India.  Sadhobur village, also known as Rampur, is located across the Ganges opposite Semara. These villages are jointly called Rampur-Semara by the locals. Semara village comes under Sherpur gram panchayat of Mohammadabad tehsil. The population of this village is around 5500 while the number of voters is 3800.
